_about: Reference screenshots (1920x1080, lossless WebP = pixel-exact) for testing the bot offline: scripts/ui_probe.py runs the bot's real detection code on a frame, scripts/loot_eval.py scores the loot reader on every frame with a 'loot' entry, scripts/panel_eval.py checks the upgrade panel, battle result and dialog readers on every frame, scripts/storage_eval.py the resource counters (gold, elixir, dark elixir: 'resources' and 'storage', how full each storage is) on every frame. Folders are named after the CoC UI they show; capture new ones with scripts/capture_frame.py and describe them here. Take templates and thresholds from these real captures, never from screen recordings (compression shifts colours).
